findings.body:
Gain 4, Work 2, Harm 2
Raise: Functional
Case: normal use - retrying an existing prototype sign-off after upgrading.
The new threshold runs only after a fresh review. If an earlier review saved `stop: true` for a P1 scored Gain 4, Work 1, Harm 3, `records.py:509–512` refuses with the owner question before reaching this code. The finding therefore still stops sign-off despite falling below the new bar. Reclassify saved product-review findings and clear a stop supported only by lesser findings before processing the saved stop. The adopted-client test starts a fresh sign-off and does not cover this state.

findings.body:
Gain 4, Work 2, Harm 2
Raise: Functional
Case: normal use - a second product-review round contains both a held P1 and a lesser finding.
Copying lesser findings into `state["known"]` leaves them open in the saved review. The stop question receives that entire result at `records.py:558–560`; `review.py:266–274` lists every open finding and asks whether to repair, split or accept those cases. Choosing split then creates a repair fix containing every open finding (`records.py:486–492`), including the lesser ones already recorded as Known issues. Thus lesser findings still require an owner choice and can enter another repair round. Settle them in the review result or restrict the sign-off question and resolution paths to held findings.
findings.title: Exclude lesser findings from sign-off questions and split repairs

stop.reason: The owner chose one more round: repair both review notes.

why: Sign-off judges a sample-data prototype by production rules: its prompt says the full production proof is due now and never says there is no back end, so labelled demo tools can get P0 and production answers can get Not done, and fix-now findings stop the owner for a repair round (GitHub issue 1303).
